title: #50 Ronald Fagerfjäll: They Made Sweden Rich

reader_summary.headline: I'm your host, Eddie Palmyan, and with me here in this studio is my friend and colleague, Nicholas Savos.
reader_summary.overview: I'm your host, Eddie Palmyan, and with me here in this studio is my friend and colleague, Nicholas Savos. I'm great and feel honored to have a true legend in Swedish business literature in our studio today. I woke up really early and I was really excited for recording this episode.

key_points.text: Today we will speak to Ronald Fagell, a Swedish journalist, editor-in-chief, author, political writer, and business historian, born in 1945.

key_points.text: Over the years, Ronald has been extremely productive, compiling more than 30 books, and numerous other publications.

key_points.text: In this episode, we will primarily speak about Ronald's book, They Made Sweden Rich, which is only available in Swedish.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this episode, we will primarily speak about Ronald's book, They Made Sweden Rich, which is only available in Swedish, with the title Dom Jode-Swerger-Rik, and covers more than the last 100 years of business history in Sweden.

It's a fascinating read, and what I like about books covering as long time spans such as this is how much is changing over long, long periods of time, while it feels that there's practically no change in real time.

thesis: The episode features a conversation with Ronald Fagerfjäll, the author of the book 'They Made Sweden Rich,' which covers over 100 years of Swedish business history. The discussion includes Fagerfjäll's personal background, his upbringing in a poor area of western Sweden, and his early experiences with reading and education that influenced his career as a journalist and business historian.
